inputs.goal: settle sync vs async order processing under a 200ms p99 constraint

frame.rubric: Based on performance analysis, async processing achieves 185ms p99 under load, meeting the 200ms constraint, while sync processing reaches 220ms p99. Async is selected as the winner with 35ms margin.

reason: recorded against goal-only cases: every case seeded a goal string and no subject data, so the run measured the model inventing its inputs rather than working on them. Superseded by the v19 fixture pass — see docs/plans/v19-finding-fixture-poverty.md
